# GarnishTable

> GarnishTable is online ordering software for independent restaurants. Each restaurant gets its own branded ordering page, a menu builder, a live order queue for staff, pickup and delivery, customer history, loyalty and promotions — for a flat monthly subscription with 0% commission on direct orders.

Key facts:

- Pricing (USD): Owner — Starter $59/month or $590/year (one location). Owner — Growth $99/month or $990/year (up to 2 locations, your own ordering domain, business-wide analytics and promotions). Agency — Growth $179/month or $1,790/year (up to 5 client restaurant businesses).
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Customers can also pay at checkout and skip the trial.
- 0% commission on direct orders.
- Customers currently pay the restaurant directly (at pickup, on delivery or at the table). Online card payments through the restaurant's own Stripe account are planned, not yet available.
- Marketplace connections (Uber Eats, DoorDash, foodpanda) are not available at launch.
- Subscriptions are sold and billed by Paddle, the merchant of record.
